n707c14d367.headline: Binance’s Teng Downplays BTC Volatility Amid Market Sell-Off
n707c14d367.summary: Binance chief Richard Teng said Bitcoin's pullback stems from a broad risk-off unwinding amid a market sell-off. He argued its volatility is in line with major traditional assets.
n707c14d367.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency and a bellwether for digital-asset risk appetite. Binance is one of the largest crypto exchanges by trading volume.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The sell-off has pushed Bitcoin lower as investors unwind risk positions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n707c14d367.why_moved: The article describes a broad market sell-off with Bitcoin pulling back. Teng attributes this to a general risk-off unwinding rather than crypto-specific factors.

n25ae0f819f.headline: Audit Report indicts NNPCL over N684 million irregular contracts, abandoned projects
n25ae0f819f.summary: An audit report cites N684 million in irregular contracts and abandoned projects at NNPC Limited. It points to weak controls, opaque transactions and potential diversion of public funds.
n25ae0f819f.why: NNPC Limited is Nigeria's state-owned oil company and a major source of government revenue. Governance findings can affect investor confidence in Nigerian energy assets.

nbc75d962a4.headline: 2025 Marks a Turning Point for the Housing Market
nbc75d962a4.summary: Hungary's real estate investment market is strengthening, with turnover expected to reach EUR 800 million, twice last year's figure. Industrial and residential investment is driving the rebound.
nbc75d962a4.why: Commercial real estate investment volumes are a gauge of capital flows into property and of the health of a country's construction and lending markets.

n042db8918e.headline: Naira-for-Crude Policy: Reps panel issues seven-day ultimatum to MDAs, warns of arrest warrants
n042db8918e.summary: A Reps panel issued a seven-day ultimatum to ministries, departments and agencies, warning of arrest warrants. Non-compliance stalled an investigative hearing into the policy's implementation.
n042db8918e.why: The naira-for-crude arrangement governs how Nigeria's oil is sold and paid for, so oversight of it affects government oil revenue and foreign-exchange supply.

nc803728ddf.headline: Tullow shares hit record low on dim production outlook
nc803728ddf.summary: Tullow Oil said 2025 production will be at the lower end of its forecast as it seeks to refinance debt. Overdue payments from the Ghanaian government sent its shares to a record low.
nc803728ddf.why: Tullow is a London-listed oil and gas producer with major assets offshore Ghana, so its output and debt position are closely watched by energy investors.

n622dd69a8a.headline: Europe close: Stocks broadly weaker amid fresh bubble fears
n622dd69a8a.summary: European equities closed broadly lower on Friday as concerns over stretched AI valuations and sharp declines in semiconductor stocks weighed. Defence shares also fell after reports of a potential Ukraine peace plan.
n622dd69a8a.why: The STOXX Europe 600 is the main benchmark for European equities, and its sector mix includes technology, semiconductors and defence.
n622dd69a8a.why_moved: Concerns about stretched AI valuations and a sharp fall in semiconductor stocks dragged the market lower. Reports of a potential Ukraine peace plan added pressure on defence shares.

n138d3d2d4c.headline: Dubai Airshow 2025: Pakistan to sell JF-17 Thunder fighter jets to
n138d3d2d4c.summary: At the Dubai Airshow, Pakistan is set to sell JF-17 Thunder fighter jets to a buyer. Azerbaijan signed a contract in 2024 to buy JF-17 Block-III jets from Pakistan for $4.6 billion.
n138d3d2d4c.why: Defence exports bring revenue to manufacturers and can shift regional military procurement and diplomatic ties.

na32133b1df.headline: Across the board selling drives QSE down 350 points: M-cap erodes QR22.59bn : QSE-November Week 3
na32133b1df.summary: The Qatar Stock Exchange closed the week weak, with its key index plunging as much as 350 points. Market capitalisation eroded by QR22.59bn as selling spread across the board.
na32133b1df.why: The Qatar Stock Exchange is the main venue for Qatari equities, and its performance reflects both local conditions and global rate expectations.
na32133b1df.why_moved: Receding hopes of a US interest-rate cut weighed on sentiment, and selling was broad across the Qatar Stock Exchange.

n741298761d.headline: Unexpected criticism for Victoria's reserve price real estate law
n741298761d.summary: Two buyer's advocates have raised concerns about the Victorian government's proposal to stamp out underquoting at property auctions. The proposal would introduce reserve prices.
n741298761d.why: Auction and underquoting rules affect how property is sold and priced in Victoria, one of Australia's largest housing markets.

n3c4d5f89a7.headline: Energy bills to rise for millions from January as bills up £700 since 2021
n3c4d5f89a7.summary: Energy bills are set to rise from January 1 after Ofgem unexpectedly increased its next price cap. The increase affects millions of households.
n3c4d5f89a7.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator, and its price cap sets maximum default tariffs, affecting household energy spending and utility company revenues.

na3d85ea88b.headline: Court vacates order freezing Nestoil's assets
na3d85ea88b.summary: A Nigerian court ruled that no subsisting ex parte order remains against Nestoil after 14 days of motion on notice, vacating the freeze on the company's assets.
na3d85ea88b.why: Asset freezes can disrupt a company's operations and creditor positions, so court rulings on them matter to investors in Nigerian oil services firms.

n28f7d5cf7b.headline: UK private sector growth slows due to business caution ahead of Budget
n28f7d5cf7b.summary: The S&P Global flash UK composite PMI fell to 50.5 in November from 52.2, with business caution ahead of the Budget slowing private sector growth.
n28f7d5cf7b.why: The PMI is a leading indicator of UK economic activity, and readings near 50 separate expansion from contraction.

n3d0717d909.headline: Starmer arrives in South Africa as G20 gathers without Trump
n3d0717d909.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer arrived in South Africa for the G20 gathering, which is taking place without Donald Trump. He aims to support British business during the trip.
n3d0717d909.why: G20 meetings bring together major economies to coordinate on trade, finance and growth. Leader-level diplomacy can influence trade access and investment for UK companies.

naa5ba65725.headline: Standoff at Nestoil headquarters as owners, receiver manager clash
naa5ba65725.summary: A standoff at Nestoil's headquarters followed a dispute between owners and the receiver-manager, who says his mandate remains intact after a court vacated a Mareva order.
naa5ba65725.why: Nestoil is a Nigerian oil company, and disputes over control of its assets affect creditors, investors and operations in the Nigerian oil sector.

n839cef0295.headline: Starmer to use G20 summit to shore up support for Ukraine and make deals
n839cef0295.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer plans to speak with Volodymyr Zelensky and the German and French leaders at the G20 summit about the US-backed peace plan. Starmer is also set to make deals at the summit.
n839cef0295.why: The G20 groups the world's major economies, so its sidelines shape diplomatic and financial coordination on the war in Ukraine.

n689e231be1.headline: Trump’s G20 boycott ‘hurts US more than world’
n689e231be1.summary: Economist Jeffrey Sachs argues that Trump's boycott of the G20 summit damages the US more than the world and isolates the country at a critical time for global leadership.
n689e231be1.why: The G20 is the main forum for coordinating economic policy among large economies, so US absence can affect trade and financial cooperation.

n85ef5abfe1.headline: 2024 was the worst economic crisis in Ghana’s history – Kwakye Ofosu
n85ef5abfe1.summary: Ghana's Minister for Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, described the 2024 economic downturn as the worst crisis in Ghana's history. He argued that its severity was unprecedented and avoidable.
n85ef5abfe1.why: Economic crises in Ghana affect sovereign debt, currency stability and investor sentiment toward West African frontier markets. Government statements on past downturns often shape policy debate.

na14e24022d.headline: Business acquisitions by foreign funds worrying, says tax commissioner
na14e24022d.summary: Tax Commissioner Soteris Markides told MPs that Cyprus should be worried about foreign companies and funds acquiring hotels, universities and hospitals, during debate on a tax reform bill.
na14e24022d.why: Cyprus is an EU member state and financial centre, and its tax rules affect foreign investment and corporate ownership.

n4c16d23e0d.headline: Energy bills to rise for millions from January as bills up £700 since 2021
n4c16d23e0d.summary: Energy bills are set to rise by 0.2 for millions of households from January 1 after Ofgem unexpectedly increased its next price cap.
n4c16d23e0d.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator, and its price cap sets the maximum unit rates suppliers can charge households, affecting inflation and consumer spending.

n43e742c962.headline: REITs and InvITs key to financing India’s Rs 700 trillion infrastructure vision: SEBI Chairman
n43e742c962.summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said India must rapidly expand its REIT and InvIT ecosystem to meet long-term infrastructure needs. He also cited boosting retail participation and asset monetisation.
n43e742c962.why: REITs and InvITs are listed vehicles that pool income-producing real estate or infrastructure assets, giving investors a route into those assets.

n336ab73a56.headline: Energy bills to rise for millions from January as bills up £700 since 2021
n336ab73a56.summary: Energy bills are set to rise from January 1 for millions of households, after Ofgem unexpectedly increased its next price cap. Bills are up £700 since 2021.
n336ab73a56.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator, and its price cap sets the maximum standard tariff that households can be charged.

n395d34fd67.headline: OpenAI and Taiwan’s Foxconn to partner in AI hardware design and manufacturing in the US
n395d34fd67.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Taiwan's Foxconn to work on AI hardware design and manufacturing in the United States.
n395d34fd67.why: Foxconn is the world's largest contract electronics manufacturer, and AI hardware partnerships shape demand for server and device production.

nfdda4ca478.headline: ASOS' shares drop after disappointing profit outlook
nfdda4ca478.summary: ASOS shares fell sharply after the UK fashion retailer's 2026 profit forecast came in below expectations. The company had reported a jump in full-year earnings.
nfdda4ca478.why: ASOS is a London-listed online fashion retailer, and its profit guidance is closely watched by investors in UK consumer stocks.

n58bd39238e.headline: Scrap windfall tax and lift ban on new oil, leading business figures urge Reeves
n58bd39238e.summary: Business figures including Martin Gilbert and Sir Ian Wood, who led two of Aberdeen's biggest firms, urged Chancellor Rachel Reeves to scrap the windfall tax and lift the ban on new oil.
n58bd39238e.why: The North Sea oil and gas sector is centred in Aberdeen, and the windfall tax and drilling policy directly shape investment in UK oil production.

ndfa075a2b5.headline: Energy price cap to rise by 0.2% from January
ndfa075a2b5.summary: Regulator Ofgem has outlined its next energy price cap, under which households will see a 0.2% rise in gas and electricity prices from January.
ndfa075a2b5.why: Ofgem regulates the energy price cap for UK households, which sets the maximum unit rates suppliers can charge and affects inflation and household budgets.

neca8bfd0fb.headline: Four Labour Codes come into force: Who benefits, what changes, and what workers must know
neca8bfd0fb.summary: India has implemented four Labour Codes effective November 21, 2025, consolidating 29 laws. The codes introduce mandatory appointment letters, universal social security and timely minimum wages.
neca8bfd0fb.why: Labour regulation shapes employment costs, compliance burdens and workforce flexibility for companies operating in India.

nf9b7d01925.headline: Reeves facing fresh pressure to axe farm inheritance tax changes in Budget
nf9b7d01925.summary: The National Farmers' Union has urged Chancellor Rachel Reeves to drop changes to farm inheritance tax ahead of the Budget, saying she cannot keep taxing businesses into the ground.
nf9b7d01925.why: Inheritance tax changes for agricultural and business assets affect farm succession, land values and the fiscal plans set out in the UK Budget.

nf67b3c96b3.headline: LyondellBasell announces quarterly dividend
nf67b3c96b3.summary: LyondellBasell has declared a dividend of $1.37 per share, payable on December 8, 2025, with an ex-dividend and record date shortly before.
nf67b3c96b3.why: LyondellBasell is a Houston-based chemicals company that produces plastics, refining products and petrochemicals, and it pays regular dividends to shareholders.

n7e50692a28.headline: Japan's $135bn stimulus plan fiscally 'responsible'
n7e50692a28.summary: Japan approved a $135 billion stimulus package, and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said it was fiscally responsible. She also said she would reduce the country's large debt burden.
n7e50692a28.why: Japan's government spending and debt levels influence its bond yields, the yen and the outlook for Japanese equities. Stimulus packages are a key lever of Japanese fiscal policy.

n4f2e52bcd6.headline: Ontario unveils Buy Ontario Act to prioritize made-in-province goods, protect workers
n4f2e52bcd6.summary: The Ontario government is advancing legislation to prioritise made-in-province goods and protect workers, which would reshape how public sector organizations operate.
n4f2e52bcd6.why: Ontario is Canada's most populous province and a major manufacturing and trade hub, so procurement rules there affect local suppliers and trade flows.

ne882db538d.headline: Euro zone business activity grows steadily in November
ne882db538d.summary: Euro zone business activity grew steadily in November, with services expanding at the quickest pace in one and a half years. Weak demand sent manufacturing back into contraction, a private survey showed.
ne882db538d.why: Purchasing managers' indexes are closely watched gauges of economic momentum, and they influence expectations for European Central Bank policy.

nf95ddeae2d.headline: Memecoins and NFTs Hit 2025 Lows as Crypto Market Erases $800B
nf95ddeae2d.summary: Memecoins dropped 66% from their yearly peak and the NFT market cap slid to April lows, as risk appetite faded in a broader crypto downturn.
nf95ddeae2d.why: Crypto markets are highly volatile and sensitive to shifts in risk appetite. Memecoins and NFTs are speculative segments that often fall fastest in downturns.
nf95ddeae2d.why_moved: The input cites fading risk appetite amid a broader crypto downturn. Speculative assets such as memecoins and NFTs typically fall hardest when investors pull back from risk.

nb2f6accdcc.headline: Markets Weekly Outlook - UK Budget in Focus as Global Equities Eye Recovery
nb2f6accdcc.summary: A weekly market outlook highlights the UK budget, the Bank of England, US shutdown effects, Fed rate-cut expectations, the dollar index and Japanese FX intervention.
nb2f6accdcc.why: The Bank of England and the Federal Reserve set interest rates that influence global bond yields, currencies and equities. UK budgets shape fiscal policy and gilt markets.

ne2fa1fbdfc.headline: Azenta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2025 Results, Ended September 30, 2025
ne2fa1fbdfc.summary: Azenta reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2025 revenue growth of 6% year over year and 4% organically. Full-year reported revenue rose 4%, with adjusted EBITDA margin up 310 basis points.
ne2fa1fbdfc.why: Azenta is a US life sciences tools and sample-management company, and its results indicate demand from biopharma and research customers.

n168229515b.headline: Australian Market Extends Early Sharp Losses In Mid-market
n168229515b.summary: The Australian stock market extended its early sharp losses in mid-market trade on Friday, reversing the previous session's gains after broadly negative Wall Street cues overnight.
n168229515b.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, and its direction reflects local sentiment and global cues from US markets.
n168229515b.why_moved: The index was reported to be falling after negative overnight cues from Wall Street, reversing the previous session's gains.

nd4c04e49c8.headline: Supermarket price squeeze puts NZ growers under pressure
nd4c04e49c8.summary: Wattie's has cut local crops including tomatoes, beetroot, corn and peaches, putting pressure on New Zealand growers amid a supermarket price squeeze.
nd4c04e49c8.why: Wattie's is a New Zealand food processor and brand, so changes to its sourcing of local produce affect domestic growers and food supply chains.

n009532d73a.headline: Irish producer prices down 3.5% annually in October - CSO
n009532d73a.summary: Irish producer prices were lower than a year earlier in October, despite a modest monthly rise, according to the Central Statistics Office. The CSO figures were published on Friday.
n009532d73a.why: Producer prices track input and output costs for manufacturers and are a leading indicator of consumer inflation.

ne97038aa78.headline: Japan approves $177 billion stimulus to mitigate inflation pain
ne97038aa78.summary: Japan has approved a $177 billion stimulus package aimed at easing the impact of persistent inflation. Inflation has contributed to the ouster of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's predecessors.
ne97038aa78.why: Fiscal stimulus in Japan, the world's fourth-largest economy, affects bond yields, the yen and the Nikkei 225, and shapes Bank of Japan policy expectations.

n466ceac7f4.headline: Playing pipeline politics: B.C. left out of rumoured Alberta MOU talks
n466ceac7f4.summary: British Columbia has been left out of rumoured talks on a memorandum of understanding between Alberta and Ottawa over a new oil pipeline. An expert says Alberta's push for the pipeline must be taken seriously.
n466ceac7f4.why: Pipeline capacity determines how Canadian crude reaches markets beyond the United States, which affects heavy oil pricing and producer revenues.

n55b2ae4ab3.headline: Bharti Telecom readies second $1 billion debt issue in two months: Sources
n55b2ae4ab3.summary: Bharti Telecom, the holding company of Bharti Airtel, is preparing a $1 billion bond sale with two- and three-year maturities. The proceeds are meant to refinance upcoming debt maturities, with mutual funds expected as major buyers.
n55b2ae4ab3.why: Bharti Airtel is one of India's largest telecom operators, and its holding company's bond issues show how the group manages its debt.

nd8e105f1fd.headline: Australian Market Sharply Lower
nd8e105f1fd.summary: The Australian stock market is trading sharply lower on Friday, reversing the previous session's gains. The decline follows broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
nd8e105f1fd.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's main benchmark index, and its direction reflects domestic equity sentiment and global risk appetite.
nd8e105f1fd.why_moved: Negative cues from Wall Street overnight prompted a sharp decline after the previous session's gains.

n7a9fbd2584.headline: More swings hit Wall Street, but this time stocks finish higher
n7a9fbd2584.summary: US stocks swung sharply during the session but finished higher. The source gives no further detail on the drivers of the moves.
n7a9fbd2584.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main barometer of US equity performance. Daily swings signal shifting investor sentiment.

n649844ab8d.headline: PETRONAS Chemicals pares losses in 3Q on lower forex loss
n649844ab8d.summary: PETRONAS Chemicals Group narrowed its net loss in the quarter ended September 30, 2025, helped by stronger operations, cost discipline and lower foreign exchange impact. The chemicals market remains challenging.
n649844ab8d.why: PETRONAS Chemicals is a Malaysian petrochemicals producer and a subsidiary of state-owned PETRONAS. Its results reflect conditions in the global chemicals cycle.

impacts.name: PETRONAS Chemicals Group
impacts.why: The company narrowed its quarterly net loss on operational gains and lower forex losses.

naea4d1686c.headline: How to Use Russia’s Frozen Assets | Council on Foreign Relations
naea4d1686c.summary: The December European Council could make a final decision on using Russia's immobilised reserves to help close Ukraine's 2026–27 financing gap. The framework may draw on more than assets held at Euroclear.
naea4d1686c.why: Russia's immobilised central bank reserves are largely held in Europe, mainly at the Belgium-based clearing house Euroclear. Their use affects EU financing and sanctions policy.

n63ab89d994.headline: Benchmark JGB yields retreat from 17-year high ahead of stimulus announcement
n63ab89d994.summary: Japanese government bond yields eased from 17-year highs as details of a 21.3 trillion yen economic stimulus plan were prepared for announcement. Super-long yields had surged earlier.
n63ab89d994.why: Japanese government bonds set benchmark borrowing costs in Japan, and fiscal stimulus can influence bond supply and inflation expectations.
n63ab89d994.why_moved: Yields had surged on concerns about the nation's finances, then eased as details of a 21.3 trillion yen stimulus plan were prepared.

n32590dd11e.headline: Explained: Why is Bitcoin, XRP down today?
n32590dd11e.summary: Total crypto market capitalisation fell more than 10% in 24 hours to $2.8 trillion. Bitcoin fell 9% to around $83,158, with over $2 billion in liquidations reported by CoinGlass.
n32590dd11e.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price moves often set the tone for the broader digital-asset market.
